scope: Read-only native v7 HTTP/1.1 framing on isolated hierarchy fixture; Python client only, not a Swift transport PASS
sourceFindings: Any uses echo.New and e.Start without setting ReadTimeout, ReadHeaderTimeout, WriteTimeout or IdleTimeout.
Echo v4.13.4 initializes new(http.Server) and configureServer does not set those timeouts.
JSON uses encoding/json Encoder on the response writer, with standard net/http response framing; no custom JSON serializer configured.
The one-second write deadline in the engine gate is armed only for engine teardown, not ordinary live requests.
